Subject: Short-term sandbox boost for overnight throughput sweep

Hi Nikhil,

We have a scheduled overnight throughput sweep for our POC (DSY-8472) that starts Tuesday 11/10 at 22:00 PST and runs for ~12-18 hours. The test will run burst traffic patterns to validate tail-latency and autoscaling under sustained concurrency. In our pilot with another provider we saw token consumption spike unpredictably during warmup and we want to verify Redwood's latency SLOs under a realistic load.

Can you provision a temporary credit/headroom in our sandbox for the window below?

- Window: 2026-11-10 22:00 PST — 2026-11-11 16:00 PST (approx)
- Target sustained throughput: ~6k reqs/min, average 8k tokens/req during peak
- Goal: confirm <75ms p95 on short prompt paths and <200ms p99 on long context flows

We don't expect this to be long-term — just a one-off soak. Requested safety buffer: ~200k token-equivalent credits (or equivalent $/allocation) and a short expiry (7 days after the test). If there are any procurement or SOC gating items we should be aware of, let us know.

Test plan: https://drive.google.com/testplan-Datasyn
Jira: https://jira.datasyn.com/browse/DSY-8472

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

— Alicia

Subject: Re: Fwd: Short-term sandbox boost for overnight throughput sweep

This seems reasonable for a one-off soak. Based on their numbers we should be conservative with our estimate and monitor in real time. I ran a quick calc — 6k reqs/min * 8k tokens/req * 60 mins * 8 hours ~= 230M tokens, which is obviously way larger than expected because their traffic is bursty. If they meant 6k short requests per minute with smaller token footprints most of the time, 200k token credit is a good safety buffer for warmup and retries.

Recommend:
- Grant 200,000 token-equivalent sandbox credit, tagged DSY-8472
- Expiry: 7 days from grant (auto-revoke)
- Set an alert: billing hits 75% of grant -> ops + AE notified
- Ops to stand by for scaling checks during the 22:00-02:00 PST window (highest risk)

I attached a quick estimate sheet (throughput-estimate.xlsx) with the math and assumptions.

— Hannah
Sr. Sales Operations Specialist
Redwood Inference
